# Young-Seok Lee — Portfolio

> ECE Ph.D. Candidate at Seoul National University (SNU), co-advised by Prof. Sangwook Nam and Prof. Jungsuek Oh.
> Research areas: Wireless Power Transfer (WPT), RF Beam-forming, Near-field Beam-focusing, Target Detection, Indoor Localization, Space Solar Power.
> Affiliation: Wave Fusion Lab, INMC, Seoul National University.

The full machine-readable content (all publications with BibTeX, education, research projects, news, reviewer activities, scholarships, teaching, coursework, programming skills) is available as a single markdown file:

- https://korbean-0311.github.io/llms-full.txt

A CV / resume PDF is also available:

- https://korbean-0311.github.io/pdfs/cv.pdf
